descriptionChirho: To pour out a liquid, especially a drink offering or libation, in the Qal stem expressing the basic active sense of pouring.
To cast or pour molten metal into a mold, forming an idol or metal object, a specialized technical sense of pouring in the Qal stem.
To cause liquid to be poured out, especially pouring libations or offerings, in the Hifil and Piel causative stems.
To be poured out as a passive, describing liquid or wrath being poured out upon someone or something, in the Hofal passive stem.
